newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to unveil OTC market draft Feb 18 - papers.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to unveil OTC market draft Feb 18 - papers.

text.p: Malaysia's securities watchdog will unveil its draft framework for over-the-counter (OTC) trading on February 18, the New Straits Times reported on Tuesday.
Securities Commission chairman Munir Abdul Majid was quoted by the newspaper as saying the draft framework would facilitate discussion on how the OTC market could be started in Malaysia.

"My preference is for OTC trading to start by the last quarter of this year, but we would have to see if all the necessary details could be met before anyone can commit to a starting date," Munir said.
The OTC market would enable high-technology firms with little track record to tap public funds.
